competences.description: Swings a giant sword to deal damage and decrease the target's Defense for 2 turns. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a sword 2 times to decrease the target's Attack Power for 2 turns with a 70% chance and absorb Attack Bar by 15% with a 70% chance. This attack will deal more damage according to your MAX HP.
Decreases the damage that other allies receive by 30%, but increases the damage you receive by 15%. This effect doesn't accumulate with other damage reduction effect skills. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
